qa.question: When did Caroline go to the LGBTQ support group?
What caching layer did they choose?
Which two systems did they combine for auth and cache?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: Hey Caroline! Swamped with the kids and work. What's new with you?

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group on 7 May 2023 and it was so powerful.

session_1.speaker: Melanie
session_1.text: That's amazing. At work we finally picked JWT with refresh token rotation for the API.

session_1.speaker: Caroline
session_1.text: Nice. We chose Redis for the caching layer with a 15-minute TTL.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: I painted a sunrise back in 2022. Nothing to do with dogs.
